doctors.summary: Dr. Ramakanth holds a Master of Dental Surgery and leads Sri Parvathi Dental Clinic, seeing patients for everyday dental care as well as root canals and tooth removal.
bio: Dr. Ramakanth is the dentist behind Sri Parvathi Dental Clinic at Pathur Road Cross, Tadepalle. He holds an MDS — a postgraduate master's degree in dental surgery taken after the five-year BDS.
Patients reviewing the clinic on Google most often mention his patience, the clinic's helpful staff and modern equipment, and treatments such as root canals and wisdom tooth removal.
At your first visit he examines your teeth and gums, explains what he finds and talks you through your options before any treatment starts.
